objective: Verify variable-capacity (n=1..4) overlapping-AST (6/6 distinct per capacity), 8-token / 64-pair / 8-codebook invariance (8/8 restricted classes per base) and 1188-settle 4-capacity stage transfer (64 role, 384 expr, 60 feasible1..4, 680 query1..4)

operationalFacts.statement: R35 tested feasible1..4 and query1..4 under mutually exclusive leaves that collapsed the 6 ASTs to 3/6-5/6 functions (with AST 2 producing 0 feasible solutions) and omitted n=1(complete=True) and n=4(complete=False). R36, R44, and R45 restricted overlapping-leaf and 8-codebook testing to n=2, complete=True only, and R46 relational consumer used only feasible2.

R35 equality(cfg) partitions 64 ordered 3-bit inputs into 4 Hamming equivalence classes d in {0,1,2,3}, feeding 6x4^3=384 exhaustive expr settles. Across capacities n in {1,2,3,4}, feasible_n has C(n,2) in {0,1,3,6} pairwise inhibition nodes (pair_i_j -> at_least_two) with 2^{n+1} Boolean corners (4+8+16+32=60), and query_n has 2^{2n+1} Boolean corners (8+32+128+512=680) driven by capacity-stratified inner-margin [false_max, true_min] bounds.

56 lower sources + 1188 stage-transfer settles (64 role + 384 expr + 60 feasible1..4 + 680 query1..4) + 28160 upper settles across n in {1,2,3,4} (320x10 + 320x18 + 320x26 + 320x34) = 29404 native settles (+ 160 exact = 1440 evaluations, 18 batches x 80). 600s total / 240s stage / raw 128MiB / cache 128MiB / AS 512MiB / worker 1 / retry 0.
